title: A deep learning model of tumor cell architecture elucidates response and resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitors.
authors: Park, Sungjoon; Silva, Erica; Singhal, Akshat; Kelly, Marcus R; Licon, Kate; Panagiotou, Isabella; Fogg, Catalina; Fong, Samson; Lee, John J Y; Zhao, Xiaoyu; Bachelder, Robin; Parker, Barbara A; Yeung, Kay T; Ideker, Trey
one_liner_zh: 该研究构建深度学习模型预测CDK4/6抑制剂反应，虽涉及转录因子RUNX1，但核心是肿瘤细胞多蛋白组装与药物响应，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 4 and 6 inhibitors (CDK4/6is) have revolutionized breast cancer therapy. However, <50% of patients have an objective response, and nearly all patients develop resistance during therapy. To elucidate the underlying mechanisms, we constructed an interpretable deep learning model of the response to palbociclib, a CDK4/6i, based on a reference map of multiprotein assemblies in cancer. The model identifies eight core assemblies that integrate rare and common alterations across 90 genes to stratify palbociclib-sensitive versus palbociclib-resistant cell lines. Predictions translate to patients and patient-derived xenografts, whereas single-gene biomarkers do not. Most predictive assemblies can be shown by CRISPR-Cas9 genetic disruption to regulate the CDK4/6i response. Validated assemblies relate to cell-cycle control, growth factor signaling and a histone regulatory complex that we show promotes S-phase entry through the activation of the histone modifiers KAT6A and TBL1XR1 and the transcription factor RUNX1. This study enables an integrated assessment of how a tumor's genetic profile modulates CDK4/6i resistance.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4和6抑制剂（CDK4/6is）已彻底改变了乳腺癌治疗。然而，<50%的患者获得客观缓解，且几乎所有患者在治疗过程中都会产生耐药性。为阐明其潜在机制，我们基于癌症中多蛋白组装体的参考图谱，构建了一个可解释的深度学习模型，用于预测CDK4/6i抑制剂palbociclib的反应。该模型识别出八个核心组装体，整合了90个基因中的罕见和常见变异，以区分palbociclib敏感与palbociclib耐药的细胞系。这些预测可转化至患者及患者来源的异种移植模型，而单基因生物标志物则无法实现。大多数预测性组装体可通过CRISPR-Cas9基因破坏实验证明其调控CDK4/6i反应。已验证的组装体涉及细胞周期控制、生长因子信号传导以及一个组蛋白调控复合体，我们证明该复合体通过激活组蛋白修饰因子KAT6A和TBL1XR1以及转录因子RUNX1促进S期进入。本研究实现了对肿瘤遗传谱如何调节CDK4/6i耐药的整合评估。
